collection.title: VW California T5 2003 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW California T5 2003 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade for both the drivers and the passengers side with a Side Pin arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. We also have rear blades for this California, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
